selection_note.en: These are post-hoc selected qualitative cases in which both methods succeed and Full has higher SPL. They are not aggregate performance estimates; the full quantitative evaluation remains in the manuscript.
selection_note.zh: 这些是事后选择的定性案例，两种方法均成功且Full的SPL更高。它们不代表总体性能估计；完整定量评测仍保留在论文正文中。

trajectory_semantics.positions: Original saved high-level poses; duplicate positions retained in JSON.
trajectory_semantics.figure_connections: Dashed links connect recorded endpoints; they do not reconstruct primitive motion.
trajectory_semantics.distance_samples: One recorded evaluator distance at pose_at_metric per decision cycle; not assumed to be after the action.
trajectory_semantics.path_length_source: Archived evaluator result, not the length of the displayed polyline.
trajectory_semantics.cost_note: Navigation path length and decision cycles are not inference-call or latency measurements.
